variants.title: Gebrochener Schiefer
variants.direction: Kühle, klar gebrochene Schieferflächen; kurze, verzweigte Risse.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: bare rock base-color material source for the existing Rock-47Blob autotile system of Fragdachse, a detailed orthographic overhead dark woodland action game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference screenshot only: take the angular natural stone facets of the rocky obstacles, not its scene layout, vegetation, darkness, fog or lighting.
Create ONE square edge-to-edge continuous exposed bedrock material texture, not a scene or atlas. Strict orthographic 90-degree vertical overhead view, no perspective, no horizon, no visible cliff side or isolated rock silhouette. Seamless/tileable in both axes, consistent scale and brightness to all edges, no border.
Physical scale: this complete square represents 4 metres by 4 metres. Game scale is 32 world pixels per metre, so the source will eventually cover about 128 by 128 game pixels. Main fractured facets must be around 20–65 cm across: about 8–12 varied main facets across the image, with occasional broad connected areas and subsidiary hairline cracks. Avoid fine gravel that disappears when reduced.
Quality: natural convincing weathered stone, crisp readable irregular planar fractures, subtle chipped edges and fine stone grain subordinate to those planes, restrained local relief. Paint-like realism suitable for the reference game; not photogrammetric macro noise, not cartoon outlines. One continuous irregular rocky mass, not a field of detached rounded boulders. Random natural fracture directions, no regular grid, no masonry, no paving or cobblestones, no black channels surrounding every shape.
IMPORTANT VALUE: reference rocks are too dark. This raw base material must be clearly lighter and readable in muted medium stone grey, with most faces around RGB 85–120, lighter planes around 130–145, recesses around 45–65, never crushed black. No global vignette or dramatic light. Broad neutral diffuse illumination; gentle local facet shading only, no strong directional shadows or strong ambient occlusion. Existing renderer supplies additional darkening and moss layers.
Absolutely bare stone: NO moss, lichen, grass, plants, roots, leaves, dirt patches, water, flowers, terrain, objects, text, labels, frame, watermark, sparkle, glowing veins, white mineral veins, wet gloss or cast shadows. Fully opaque square.

Variant: cool slate-grey weathered fractured bedrock. Moderately angular flat faces with subtle stepped lamination, short branching cracks and broken triangular chips. Cool desaturated blue-grey mixed with neutral grey, no blue cast stronger than the game rock. Natural varied planes, connected calm face areas between small chips. Closest to the reference stone character, lifted midtones.
